product.title: Downtown Austin Sunset Kayak Tour with 1.5 Million Bats

description.text: Paddle the Austin skyline at golden hour, then stage under Congress Avenue Bridge for the Mexican free-tailed bat emergence. This guided kayak outing lasts about 2.5 hours and includes equipment with an interpretive bat briefing. Stops include Kayak Launch, Austin Skyline Paddle, Congress Avenue Bridge, Bat Emergence Viewing. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Austin skyline views, lake corridors, and Hill Country highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Austin who want a guided Capital City experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
